title: The Keep
note: Bill mentions during the Miami Vice: Calderone's Return ep that they'll do every MIchael Mann movie on The Rewatchables
plot: Set during World War II, a German army garrison is sent to guard a mountain pass in a village in Romania's Carpathian mountains and sets up barracks in an ancient stone fortress. Two of the soldiers unwittingly release a mysterious entity that kills or corrupts those within its influence, drawing the attention of a Gestapo commander, a Jewish scholar, and a mysterious traveller.
